subject.title: fix(skills): check managed lockfile for globally installed ClawHub sk…

question: Should this PR wait for a maintainer-run registry-backed global installation, or is the contributor's synthetic ClawHub metadata proof sufficient for this narrow lockfile-selection change?
rationale: The contributor cannot access a usable registry skill, while repository policy requires real after-fix behavior proof for external runtime PRs; accepting an approximation or supplying privileged proof requires human judgment.

options.title: Run registry-backed proof
options.body: A maintainer with ClawHub access runs a real `--global` registry install and captures the resulting user-facing linked status before merge.

options.title: Accept synthetic proof
options.body: Accept the real local global install plus manually recreated registry metadata as sufficient because the changed function only selects between already parsed lockfile inputs.

recommendation.title: Run registry-backed proof
recommendation.body: A maintainer with ClawHub access runs a real `--global` registry install and captures the resulting user-facing linked status before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent managed-skill root and symlink history makes this the strongest available owner for deciding whether the remaining integration-proof gap is material.
